race.description: Tabtouch - Westspeed Platinum Spring Series Fnl Hcp
race.comment: BOSUN (1) has been in red-hot form this prep, putting together three wins after a solid first-up second. Renews acquaintances with a lot of horses he defeated last start and rises in weight and drawn the outside, but you can't put anything past him the way he's going. SWIFT TALKER (3) could be the danger because even though beaten by BOSUN last start, he was only first-up, meets him better at the weights and draws to advantage. I LOVE YA MONEY (7) finished fifth in the BOSUN race last start but might not have loved leading and is probably going to be given a more patient ride by Pike. JAZALOT (2) didn't feature behind BOSUN last start but the form prior was good and deserves another shot from the good draw. TRIPLE THE CHANT (8) can get a little closer to BOSUN this time from a low draw.
